data.content: A printable Christmas party bundle: 6 party games, 12 party awards, a white elephant dice game, a left-right gift story and a gingerbread house contest with score cards and ribbons. Host timeline and answer keys included. Print at home for a family, office or friends Christmas party.

The kit also has a gift idea list by budget (under $10, $20 and $30), name-draw slips, a tracker, gift tags and thank-you notes. 11 pages for office, school or family exchanges. US Letter or A4.
